# Kovai Lakshmi Grinders

![Kovai Lakshmi Grinders Logo](https://kovailakshmi.in/LOGO/KOVAI%20LAKSHMI%20GRINDERS%20LOGO.png)

> Kovai Lakshmi Grinders is a family-run manufacturer of commercial wet grinders and food-processing machinery in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India, established in 1983. It builds and sells hotel and kitchen equipment, bakery and snack-making machines and agri processing machines from its own factory in Peelamedu, Coimbatore, with shops in Coimbatore, Chennai and Salem and delivery across India.

Coimbatore (Kovai) is known across India as the home of the wet grinder and Kovai Lakshmi Grinders has made grinders there since 1983. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified, registered under MSME (Udyam) and now in its third generation of family leadership, represented by Danusree Rajendran, Chief Operating Officer. Its range of 64 machines covers commercial tilting, conventional and instant rice grinders, chapathi, idiyappam, vegetable, garlic, chilli and onion machines, cook woks, gravy machines, dosa tawas and bain maries for hotels, restaurants, canteens and caterers; ladoo, murukku, adhirasam, namkeen and halwa machines, fryers, dough sheeters, planetary mixers and packaging machines for sweet shops, bakeries and snack makers; and destoners, hullers, pulverizers, roasters, dryers, oil expellers (including the traditional wooden chekku) and coconut milk extractors for grain, pulse, spice and oil processing. Machines can be customised to a buyer's requirements and the company offers expert guidance, installation and demonstration, custom kitchen layouts, after-sales service and genuine spare parts. Prices are not listed on the website; quotations are given on request by phone, WhatsApp or the enquiry form.

The range covers tilting, conventional and instant rice grinders, atta kneaders, chapathi and idiyappam machines, vegetable, potato, garlic, chilli and onion machines, gravy machines, cook woks, dosa tawas, bain maries and meat mincers. (26 machines)
- [Bakery Equipment | Kovai Lakshmi Grinders](https://kovailakshmi.in/bakery-equipment/): Machines for sweet shops, bakeries and snack makers, built by Kovai Lakshmi Grinders in Coimbatore. Choose from ladoo, murukku, adhirasam, namkeen and halwa making machines, dough sheeters, planetary mixers, bread slicers, deep fryers and batch fryers, along with chips and french fries cutters, oil dryers, masala coating, popcorn, cotton candy, cream separator and band sealing machines. (23 machines)
- [Agri Machineries | Kovai Lakshmi Grinders](https://kovailakshmi.in/agri-machineries/): Processing machines for grains, pulses, spices and oil seeds from Kovai Lakshmi Grinders, Coimbatore. The range includes destoners, hullers, husk removers, urad dal skin removers, vibro shifters, pulverizers, uruli roasting machines, tray dryers, garlic bulb breakers, coconut milk extractors and oil expellers including the traditional wooden chekku. (15 machines)

Key details: Capacity: 10 kg to 100 kg per hour (varies by model); Motor: 1 HP to 10 HP (depending on machine size); Material: Stainless Steel / Mild Steel.
- [Rotary Oil Expeller Machine](https://kovailakshmi.in/agri-machineries/rotary-oil-expeller-machine/): The Rotary Oil Expeller Machine (also known as Chekku Oil Machine or Wooden Ghani) is a traditional yet advanced oil extraction unit designed to produce pure, cold-pressed oil from various seeds such as groundnut, coconut, sesame, sunflower, mustard and castor. Key details: Capacity: 15 to 25 kg per hour (varies by seed type); Motor Power: 3 HP to 7.5 HP (Single or Three Phase); Material: Wooden / Stainless Steel / Mild Steel Construction. Demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=29tLn5WjhrA
- [Wooden Chekku (Rotary Oil Expeller Machine)](https://kovailakshmi.in/agri-machineries/wooden-chekku-rotary-oil-expeller-machine/): The Wooden Chekku Oil Expeller Machine is a traditional, eco-friendly oil extraction unit designed to produce cold-pressed, pure and chemical-free oil. Key details: Capacity: 15 - 25 kg per hour (varies with seed type); Motor Power: 3 HP to 7.5 HP (Single Phase or Three Phase); Material: Wooden Chamber with Stainless Steel Drum. Demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=29tLn5WjhrA
- [Coconut Milk Extractor Machine](https://kovailakshmi.in/agri-machineries/coconut-milk-extractor-machine/): The Coconut Milk Extractor Machine is specially designed to extract pure and fresh coconut milk efficiently from grated or deshelled coconuts. Key details: Capacity: 20 kg to 200 kg per hour (varies by model); Motor Power: 1 HP to 5 HP (Single Phase / Three Phase); Material: Fully Stainless Steel (SS 304 Grade).
- [Cyclone Pulverizer](https://kovailakshmi.in/agri-machineries/cyclone-pulverizer/): Our Cyclone Pulverizer is built for fast, fine and hygienic grinding of spices, grains, pulses and dry ingredients. Key details: Capacity: 100 - 150 kg per hour (varies by material and mesh size); Motor Power: 10 HP; Material of Construction: SS 304 contact parts, with MS or SS body (your choice).
- [Tray Type Pulverizer](https://kovailakshmi.in/agri-machineries/tray-type-pulverizer/): Our Tray Type Pulverizer is designed for efficient grinding of spices, grains, pulses and other dry ingredients. Key details: Capacity: 30 - 80 kg per hour, depending on model and material; Motor Power: 2 HP, 3 HP and 5 HP; Material of Construction: MS body with SS food-contact parts.
- [Plate Mill Pulverizer](https://kovailakshmi.in/agri-machineries/plate-mill-pulverizer/): Our Plate Mill Pulverizer is designed for efficient grinding of spices and other suitable dry materials into fine powder. Key details: Capacity: 80 kg per hour (5 HP), 100 kg per hour (7.5 HP); Motor Power: 5 HP and 7.5 HP; Material of Construction: Mild steel (MS) body.
- [Tray Dryer](https://kovailakshmi.in/agri-machineries/tray-dryer/): The Tray Dryer is designed to remove moisture from food products through controlled heating and air circulation. Key details: Number of Trays: 10 (10-tray model) or 12 (12-tray model); Power Consumption: 800 W (10-tray), 1,000 W (12-tray); Tray Material: SS 304; Warranty: 1 year.
